name: Alternate Assist Mod
description: Threshold-gated legacy Ship straight-flight controller. Native clicks pass through below the configured CPS trigger; above threshold, the original velocity-hysteresis press/release controller takes over independently of manual click timing.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Ship Assist
assist-enabled.description: Below Manual Trigger CPS, all Ship input passes through normally. Above the threshold, the original velocity-feedback controller takes over.

trigger-cps.name: Manual Trigger CPS
trigger-cps.description: Manual press frequency required to activate the assist. Two consecutive press intervals must meet this threshold.

max-cps.name: Maximum Assist CPS
max-cps.description: Limits controller press/release switching. It does not force a fixed CPS; corrections are driven by actual vertical velocity.

straightness.name: Straightness
straightness.description: 100% reproduces the original Extreme Straight deadzone (0.18). Lower values widen the velocity deadzone and make corrections less aggressive.

target-vertical-velocity.name: Target Vertical Velocity
target-vertical-velocity.description: Desired gravity-relative vertical velocity. Zero targets horizontal flight.

manual-activity-window.name: Assist Hold After Last Click (s)
manual-activity-window.description: How long the controller remains armed after the last manual click. A physically held key keeps it armed until release.

route-player2-jump-to-player1.name: Route Up Arrow / Player 2 Jump to Player 1 in Single-Player
route-player2-jump-to-player1.description: In single-player levels, route P2 jump events to P1 so Up Arrow can control Player 1 when mapped to Jump P2. Dual levels keep P2 independent.

player2-enabled.name: Enable Player 2 Assist
player2-enabled.description: Enables threshold-gated assistance for Player 2 in dual levels.

debug-telemetry.name: Debug Controller Telemetry
debug-telemetry.description: Logs manual CPS, threshold, selected deadzone, vertical velocity, automatic input state, update calls, and manual event count.
